title.zh: Malicious bots are actively probing exposed Bitcoin payment servers to steal master administrative keys
title.en: Malicious bots are actively probing exposed Bitcoin payment servers to steal master administrative keys

current_state.zh: BTCPay Server warns that malicious bots are actively probing exposed Lightning nodes for a restart-time weakness that could grant administrative control and enable theft of merchant wallets, with version 2.4.4 patching the issue but custom reverse proxies remaining at risk.
